title: Quick poll (two-role example)
status: Worked example for the moment view
purpose: A teacher asks the room one question and sees the answers come in.
user: A teacher running a lesson, and learners on their phones.

commitments.text: A learner never has to find or click anything to follow the teacher.
The teacher sees every answer the moment it is given.

screens.name: Lobby
screens.viewer: Teacher: Mr Novak, at the front of the room, laptop on the projector.
screens.arrives_knowing: He has just created the poll and shared the join link.
screens.purpose: See who has joined and start the poll.
screens.achieve: Start when the room is ready.
know: Learners see a waiting message until he starts.
evaluate: The joined count changes when a learner arrives.

screens.name: Poll running
screens.viewer: Teacher: Mr Novak, watching answers arrive on the projector.
screens.expects: The question and a running count of answers
screens.achieve: Know when most of the room has answered.
know: Nothing here asks him to wait or refresh.
evaluate: The tally rises by one for each answer.

screens.name: Waiting
screens.viewer: Learner: Jana, on her phone, joined two minutes early.
screens.arrives_knowing: She tapped the link on the board.
screens.expects: Confirmation she is in the right room
screens.purpose: Know she is in and that the question will appear by itself.

sees.text: "You are in. The question will appear here."

know: She does not need to do anything.
evaluate: No control is on the screen.

screens.name: Question
screens.arrives_knowing: She was told the question would appear.
evaluate: The question is on screen without a tap.

screens.name: Answered
know: She can put the phone down.
evaluate: The message appears within a second of the tap.
